name: NTZ Recruiting Copilot
description: Multi-tenant talent acquisition copilot. Drafts job descriptions, builds interview kits, researches candidates, and generates recruiting documents using SharePoint grounding.

conversation_starters.title: Draft a Job Description
conversation_starters.text: Draft a job description using our JD template and competency framework. Use placeholders for department, level, and salary unless I specify them.

conversation_starters.title: Research a Candidate
conversation_starters.text: Research publicly available professional information about this candidate and summarize it against the role's competency framework.

conversation_starters.title: Build an Interview Kit
conversation_starters.text: Build a structured interview kit with competency-based questions, an evaluation rubric, and interviewer guidance using our interview template.

conversation_starters.title: Generate a Scorecard
conversation_starters.text: Generate a candidate scorecard and consolidate interviewer feedback into a structured hiring recommendation for recruiter review.

conversation_starters.title: Generate Outreach Message
conversation_starters.text: Generate a professional outreach or screening message template for this candidate and role.

conversation_starters.title: Generate Recruiting Document
conversation_starters.text: Generate a professionally formatted .docx version of the job description, interview kit, scorecard, or recruiting report discussed in this conversation.

conversation_starters.title: Generate Recruiting Cover
conversation_starters.text: Generate a professional cover page or header image for this job description, interview kit, or recruiting report using GraphicArt.
